profile_text.body:
Cartesia is a for-profit startup founded in 2023 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. Its website describes the company as building AI that learns and interacts like humans, and states that its team has pioneered AI architectures including state space models (SSMs), Mamba and H-Nets.

The company's main described offering is Sonic-3.6, a streaming text-to-speech API for real-time speech generation. Cartesia says the system produces natural, expressive voices, including laughter, across 44 languages, and that it is built for AI agents and interactive applications. The site frames this work as part of a broader mission to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world in the way humans do.

No lawsuits involving the company are listed. Its law exposure is recorded in California, with a count of 281.
